subject: EU Data Localization MAP: kickoff, stakeholders & timeline
raw_text:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elisabeth Moreau <elisabeth.m@euracorp.com>, Tomás Ruiz <tomas.ruiz@greenbank.es>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 12 Jul 2026 09:02:00 +0200
Subject: EU Data Localization MAP: kickoff, stakeholders & timeline

Hello Elisabeth and Tomás,

Thanks for the time on Friday. As discussed, I'm kicking off a mutual action plan (MAP) to align on EU data residency, cross-border flows, and the evaluation timeline so your security and legal teams can sign off on a constrained pilot and then a production rollout.

Attached is an initial MAP workbook (v1) with proposed milestones and owners. High level:
- Week 0: MAP kickoff & stakeholder RACI (today)
- Week 1-2: Technical assessment & proof-of-concept (networking, data flows, encryption at rest)
- Week 3: Compliance review (data residency, retention policies, audit logs)
- Week 4: Pilot sign-off / legal OK

Action items I suggest for this thread:
1) Please confirm the primary compliance contact at EuraCorp who will own the cross-border review.
2) EuraCorp to confirm required evidence types (SOC2, encryption attestations, data flow diagrams).
3) Redwood to share a POC checklist and SOC2 questionnaire filled.

We've pre-populated the MAP with owners from our side: Marissa (sales ops) will run checkpoints, Hannah (security engineering) will lead the technical questionnaire, and I'll coordinate legal/contract touches.

Available times for a 30-min MAP sync this week: Tue/Wed 10:00-12:00 CEST. If you prefer, propose a time and I'll send a calendar invite.

Attachments: [Attachment: EuraCorp_MAP_v1.xlsx]

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com | +44 20 7946 1001

----
From: Elisabeth Moreau <elisabeth.m@euracorp.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Tomás Ruiz <tomas.ruiz@greenbank.es>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 11:15:00 +0200
Subject: Re: EU Data Localization MAP: kickoff, stakeholders & timeline

Hi Rishi — thanks for the clear plan and the MAP draft.

Quick notes from EuraCorp: our primary compliance lead for this scope will be Sofia Bell (cc'ed below). Tomás will own infrastructure side coordination for the Spanish region. For the cross-border question, our Legal team typically requires:
- explicit list of data types that will leave EU boundaries (if any),
- encryption in transit and at rest,
- vendor-subprocessor list and locations,
- standard contractual clauses if personal data is involved.

Can you confirm whether Redwood's hosted endpoints keep EU-resident data entirely within EU cloud regions for the pilot? If not, we need to understand the fallback behavior.

Availability: Thu 14:00 CEST or Fri 09:00 CEST work for Sofia and me.

Thanks,
Elisabeth
Head of GDPR & Compliance | EuraCorp Financial Services
elisabeth.m@euracorp.com

On Mon, Jul 13, 2026 at 11:20 AM CEST Sofia Bell <sofia.bell@euracorp.com> wrote:
> Adding myself here — happy to take point on the compliance questionnaire and collect legal inputs. One ask: can Redwood supply a data flow diagram and a sample retention policy for PII?
>
> Sofia Bell
> Compliance Lead | EuraCorp

----
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elisabeth Moreau <elisabeth.m@euracorp.com>, Tomás Ruiz <tomas.ruiz@greenbank.es>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 13 Jul 2026 16:40:00 +0200
Subject: Re: EU Data Localization MAP: kickoff, stakeholders & timeline

Elisabeth / Tomás — great, thanks. I've updated the MAP workbook with a suggested RACI and added a separate worksheet for evidence requested by compliance. Latest items added:
- Evidence column: SOC2 report (redacted), network topology diagram, KV cache behavior, retention windows per data class.
- Owners: Hannah to produce technical artifacts; Legal (Rishi) to coordinate SCCs/contracting.
- Weekly checkpoints: Fridays 09:00 CEST (standing 30-min) through the pilot.

I've uploaded the latest MAP and a filled SOC2 questionnaire to a shared Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/file/d/1a2bEuraMapDraft (see MAP_v1 and SOC2_questionnaire_filled.pdf).

[Attachment: SOC2_questionnaire_filled.pdf]

If Friday 09:00 is not workable, suggest Tue 10:30 and we'll adapt.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com

----
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elisabeth Moreau <elisabeth.m@euracorp.com>, Sofia Bell <sofia.bell@euracorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Tomás Ruiz <tomas.ruiz@greenbank.es>
Date: Wed, 15 Jul 2026 08:30:00 +0200
Subject: Re: EU Data Localization MAP: kickoff, stakeholders & timeline

Elisabeth / Sofia — thanks for the quick replies and for confirming owners.

To confirm next steps:
- Marissa will send a calendar invite for the recurring Friday checkpoints (first meeting 2026-07-17 09:00 CEST).
- Hannah will attach a short data-flow diagram and sample retention policy to the MAP by Thu EOD.
- Redwood will scope any non-EU failover behavior and provide SCC / contractual notes for legal review.

Please review the MAP v1 in the Drive link and add any missing evidence requests directly into the workbook so we can prioritize. If we can close the compliance checklist in three weeks, we can start a limited pilot in early August.

I'll open a HubSpot MAP record (DEAL-8921) and keep the timeline visible there: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/company/8921

Best regards,
Rishi

[Attachment: EuraCorp_MAP_v1.xlsx]
